decisions.decision: Use coarse granularity with parallel plan execution.
decisions.rationale: Keep the greenfield MVP in a few broad vertical slices while allowing independent plans to run together.

decisions.decision: Use YOLO mode with adaptive models and all quality gates enabled.
decisions.rationale: Auto mode is intended to proceed without repeated approvals while retaining research, plan checks, verification, and drift protection.
The project is tracked in an existing Git repository and the planning artifacts are useful project history.
Each phase should deliver an end-to-end user capability for the Running Dashboard.

decisions.decision: MVP scope is local FIT import and six-week run analysis only.
decisions.rationale: Training plans, AI, Garmin sync, accounts, social features, and other integrations are explicitly deferred.
